description: This file is a JavaScript module implementing a calculus engine that performs derivatives, integrals, and limits by utilizing the mathjs library. It provides an async function 'calculate' that takes calculation options, performs symbolic or numeric computations, and generates LaTeX output along with intermediate steps.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Performs symbolic calculus operations like derivative, integral, and limit based on provided options, returning LaTeX formatted results and steps.

methods.name: getStepLatex
methods.description: Exports intermediate step LaTeX representations of calculations, currently a stub that returns precomputed steps.
